verdict.rationale: Unleash documents role-based access control at both root and project levels, with predefined roles and, for Enterprise, custom root and project roles. Backend API tokens can be scoped to specific projects and a single environment, which together let a platform engineer restrict who can change which flags. Missing for 10: detail on per-flag or per-environment permission granularity beyond the project level, custom roles shown only for Enterprise, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can restrict who can change which flags with roles, permissions, and scoped API tokens

citations.quote: Unleash implements role-based access control at root and project levels, with predefined and custom roles for precise permission management.
Enterprise users can create their own custom root roles and custom project roles.
Backend tokens are scoped to one or more projects and a single environment.
Role-based access control and custom project roles
